findings.claim_text: The two models agree on the composite and differ on every one of its ten parts — and the disagreement is not scattered noise, it is sorted by evaluation family, which is precisely the condition under which a single scalar stops carrying information about the thing it is being used to decide.
Artificial Analysis published Grok 4.6 at 61 on 12 August 2026 [^34]; its model page reports 44 today [^35].
$0.13 per Index task is a real measurement of one seller's list price on one endpoint on one day — not a property of the model, and not a cost any third party can presently obtain.
